info.title: Conduit Gateway API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible API for multi-provider LLM access - Requires Bearer token authentication

sourceIP.description: IP address that requested the ephemeral key

userAgent.description: User agent that requested the ephemeral key

purpose.description: Purpose or intended use of the ephemeral key

EphemeralKeyMetadata.description: Optional metadata for tracking ephemeral key usage

ephemeralKey.description: The ephemeral key token to use for authentication

EphemeralKeyResponse.description: Response when creating an ephemeral key

functionConfigurationId.description: The function configuration ID to execute.

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the function.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to associate with the execution.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate executions.

oneOf.description: Optional metadata about the ephemeral key request

GenerateEphemeralKeyRequest.description: Request for generating an ephemeral key

expirationMinutes.description: How many minutes the URL should be valid (1-10080).

GenerateUrlRequest.description: Request to generate a temporary download URL.

VideoGenerationTaskResponse.description: Response for async video generation task creation.

VideoGenerationTaskStatus.description: Status information for a video generation task.

VirtualKey.description: ConduitLLM virtual key supplied as an opaque Bearer token.
